workload.description: Two sequential alpine:3.23 echo steps, HTTP-triggered, cache disabled, no sleep. Measured on the default local integration-up executor.

task_run_insert.justification: RegisterTasks inserts both task_runs in one statement. write_slack allows at most two leftover 2-task jobs after the quiet wait. When writes stay at 2, statements must stay at 1 so an unbatched INSERT cannot hide behind matching completions.

task_run_status.justification: Local path is StartTask+CompleteTask per step plus one predecessor-decrement UPDATE (5 rows / 5 statements). min_writes 4 is start+complete of both tasks. Slack covers one leftover job, claim-path double counting, and a couple of dispatch releases on hosted CI runners. Same-work extra statements still fail the isolated batching rule.

event_insert.justification: Instrumented events: 1 register ready, 2 started, 2 succeeded, 1 successor ready. Extract completion batches succeeded+ready (6 rows / 5 statements). Uninstrumented run_started/run_completed are out of scope. Slack covers leftover jobs; same-work extra statements fail isolated batching.

lease_renewal.reason: Timer-driven worker heartbeats and reclaim loops are not isolated on the shared integration server and are not assumed deterministic.

callback.reason: This DAG declares no callbacks. Leftover jobs from earlier suite methods may still write callback_runs, so an exact zero would be a false bound.

command.reason: Reserved for future run_commands. This workload must not emit it; a non-zero delta is unexpected new SQL work.

checkpoint.reason: Reserved for future run_checkpoints. The default local lane must not emit it for this DAG.
